#Cubs

research.facts:
Rotation Market Reality — Peralta's Price Tag
**Key Facts:**
- Freddy Peralta (FA after 2026, was with Rays after trade from Brewers via Mets):
- Seeking 7-to-8-year deal per Bob Nightengale / reports (Bleacher Nation, Nov 3)
- Craig Counsell managed him in Milwaukee
- Cubs linked per Sahadev Sharma (The Athletic), ClutchPoints report
- Two-time All-Star; "late-season surge" with Rays per MLB.com profile
- Cubs' rotation situation:
- 5 starters gone: Imanaga, Gausman, Peterson, Boyd, Holmes (confirmed Nov 13 pipeline)
- Ben Brown: cervical spine surgery Nov 9; return expected mid-2027
- Cade Horton: Tommy John surgery; return expected mid-2027
- Michael King: status murky — The Athletic earlier reported Cubs and King "don't appear to be a fit," but other sources still link them. MEDIUM confidence on current status.
- Adrian Morejon also mentioned as a Cubs target (The Athletic / Sharma)
